# Automatic config spacing implementation plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Fix PR4 finding #4 without changing existing generated bytes.

**Architecture:** Keep automatic intent in the frozen config; resolve its numeric value at stage construction and numerical readers. Existing stage specs remain concrete.

**Tech Stack:** Python dataclasses, NVIDIA Warp, pytest and Sphinx.

**Spec:** ../specs/2026-10-27-auto-spacing-design.md (exact approach approved by user).

## Global Constraints

- `spacing=None` remains None; `resolved_spacing` returns explicit float or `0.6 * float(half_width)`.
- Replacing width follows the new width only for automatic spacing; explicit spacing remains fixed.
- No changes to seeded generation bytes, RNG/defaults, solver math, goldens, media, package version or immutable tags.
- One commit for finding #4; only push after CPU, docs/snippets, CUDA/full Spark and same-machine rc3 byte comparisons pass.
- Preserve user-owned untracked files. No main merge/final release.

## Review Focus

- Frozen config subclasses and repeated replacement preserve intent.
- `asdict`/JSON reconstruction retains automatic versus explicit intent.
- Generic Params mapping must resolve at the constant-spacing boundary only.
- Specs continue to serialize concrete numeric spacing; reference/oracle and storyboard readers must accept the new config contract.
- Existing generated arrays remain byte-identical to fresh rc3 snapshots on the same GPU machine.
